description: A small open cardboard box sits on the table near a closed laptop and an open notebook, with a paper cup, tissues, a blue packet, some clothes, and a large bottle scattered nearby. The left hand pulls the cardboard box closer and holds it steady while the right hand picks up the cup, then the crumpled tissue, then the blue packet, and drops each into the box; next the right hand lifts the green garment and orange cloth and stuffs them into the box, then grabs the large bottle and lays it on top before both hands slide the box back to the left to clear the workspace.
